_comment: latency is a Go duration added to every RPC to resemble a round trip. speed multiplies the scenario clock (scenarios.json and the model lifecycles): 1 is real time, 10 plays a 5 minute scenario in 30 seconds. manifestWorkReplicaSetEnabled is what GetHubCapabilities reports and what gates a placed model: true runs the fake's ManifestWorkReplicaSet controller, false makes CreateModel with a placement answer FailedPrecondition (the CRD accepts the object, nothing reconciles it). observabilityInstalled and acmVersion are reported by GetHubCapabilities as written here; all values are fixture settings, not observations of any environment.
